rationale: Multi-agent deliberation contains semantic synthesis, contradiction resolution and consensus-proposal points where the existing Decision Fabric can advise over an already-authorized participant and candidate set. It must never construct or expand that set, authorize actions, route models, admit providers, allocate resources, decide identity, or promote evidence.

decision_points.purpose: synthesize evidence-backed positions and contradictions after deterministic participant admission and policy filtering

project_radar_review.scope: steviebuilds/agent-room, agent-room-alkl/agent-room, msitarzewski/agent-room plus existing FA3 agent/orchestration fabrics
project_radar_review.note: No upstream runtime or control plane is admitted by this assessment.
